description: Miesiac, the Moon of Slavic beliefs, a tall slender young shepherd of the stars glowing like the full moon, a luminous pale silver face and body, a long flowing silver robe with a soft blue glow, two curved crescent horns on his head like a sickle moon, holding a big silver crescent sickle, glowing cold silver eyes, a few small stars around him, one bright wide shape filling the whole picture, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, majestic and menacing, floating, full body, three-quarter view, the figure alone, no clouds, no ground, no background, the whole figure inside the picture, the sickle too
